description: article_receipt_family_tree_v1 fallback plus an optional page-shape diff archive. Pages are free-inverse sorted by skeleton hash/category/template/title, then a decoder-built shape cache emits COPY_SHAPE plus slot patches or COPY_PRIOR_PAGE plus prefix/suffix tree patch events before the semantic receipt graph coder.
codec: opcode article semantic receipt graph with page-shape diff preimage
notes: No serialized shape table: decoder rebuilds shape and page caches from decoded pages. Complete archive selection falls back to article_receipt_family_tree_v1 unless the page-shape graph stream is smaller.
